in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jasraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jasraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Jas' meaning heart and 'Raj' meaning ruler. It signifies the one who rules over the heart, evoking feelings of love, compassion, and bravery.
